hooks.command: uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/safety_guard.py" || { status=$?; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks safety hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$status" >&2; exit 2; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pre_git_hook.py" || { status=$?; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks git policy hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$status" >&2; exit 2; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/post_tool_use.py" || { status=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks logging hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$status" >&2; exit 0; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/system_notification.py" --success || { status=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks notification hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$status" >&2; exit 0; }
